keys.detail: the refresh works; Google set no 7-day Testing limit on it
fix: Signed in to Google as the studio account only, open https://quickplay-studio.github.io/quickplay-autopilot/youtube-callback.html and press Sign in to YouTube.
When Google asks which channel, pick Quickplay Daily. On the permissions page tick Select all, then Continue.
Press Copy code on the page that opens.

Within 5 minutes open https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/actions/workflows/social.yml, press Run workflow, paste the code into "YouTube address or code", type main as the channel, and press the green Run workflow.
The next key check (within 3 hours) closes this issue; to see it at once press Run workflow on https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/actions/workflows/audit.yml.
If this comes back about 7 days after each sign-in, Google's app is still in Testing: publish it at https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/audience (Publish app) and sign in once more.

keys.detail: answers as @quickplaydaily
fix: Open https://developers.facebook.com/apps and choose the Quickplay app, signed in as the studio account.
Instagram, then API setup with Instagram login, then Generate token for the account this key belongs to.
Copy the token and paste it into the GitHub secret IG_TOKEN (Update secret): https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/settings/secrets/actions/IG_TOKEN
The key in use is kept in tokens/instagram.enc and is only replaced when that file is removed: ask Claude (your pinned Quickplay page) to remove it so the new IG_TOKEN seeds a fresh one.
Press Run workflow on https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/actions/workflows/audit.yml: from then on the audit refreshes the key every week by itself.

fix: Open https://developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer/ signed in as the studio account and choose the Quickplay app.

Under Permissions add pages_manage_posts, pages_manage_engagement, pages_read_engagement, pages_read_user_content, pages_show_list and read_insights, then press Generate Access Token and allow it for the Quickplay Daily Page.

Copy the token and paste it into the GitHub secret FB_PAGE_TOKEN (Update secret): https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/settings/secrets/actions/FB_PAGE_TOKEN. A user key is fine: the automation swaps it for the Page's own key, which lasts as long.

keys.what: FreeLLMAPI router (more free models and web search for the writers and fact packs)
keys.detail: started Friday 30 October (trends): 26 chat models on kilo, ovh; search on none; this release does not know keenable, so it is left out
fix: Nothing is lost while it is down: the writers and fact packs use the other free models, as before it existed.

Press Run workflow on https://github.com/quickplay-studio/quickplay-autopilot/actions/workflows/freellm.yml to try it again (about 2 minutes): it saves the reason, and what the container said, in status/freellm.json.

If the reason is "image digest changed": read the release notes at https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi/releases, then ask Claude (your pinned Quickplay page) to set freellm.digest in config.json.
To switch it off for good, set "on": false under "freellm" in config.json.
